description: Instantaneous ionisation rates (1/s) and Gaussian-pulse yields of the noble gases at 800 nm in Luna.jl, solprop and optmat, on the same fields: written by tools/legacy_ionisation_rates.jl, then tools/legacy_ionisation_rates.py solprop, then ... optmat.

pulses.form: optmat.gas.ionisation_validation.gaussian_pulse: field = -dA/dt, A = -(F0/omega) e(t) sin(omega t + cep), e = exp(-2 ln2 t^2/fwhm^2); 96 samples per cycle over 3.0 FWHM either side
pulses.yield: 1 - exp(-int W dt), trapezoid rule on the pulse's own grid

luna.function: Luna.Ionisation.IonRatePPTCached(gas, 800e-9) = IonRatePPTAccel(gas, 800e-9; cache=true), as built by Interface.makeplasma! for plasma=true (PPT_options empty)
luna.options: stark_shift=true, dipole_corr=true (both inactive for Kr and Xe: no polarisability in Luna), msum=true, occupancy=2, sum_integral=true, cycle_average=false, Cnl from the asymptotic (Hartree) expression with l* = n* - 1; spline N=2^16 up to twice the barrier-suppression field, error above it

solprop.function: solprop.driver.simulation._ionisation_rate(gas, True, 800e-9) = solprop.nonlinear.ionisation.PPT(gas, 800e-9), the capillary driver's plasma=True rate for the noble gases
solprop.options: defaults: sum_integral=True, bsi='auto' (Tong-Lin, alpha 7 for He and 9 for the others), cycle_averaged=False, stark_shift=True, dipole_correction=True (both inactive for Kr and Xe: no polarisability in solprop), m_sum=True, occupancy=2, coulomb_factor=None (the asymptotic C_n*l* with l* = n* - 1), maximum 1/au_time
